fusions.name: Thudding Kicks
fusions.desc: A heavy kick that deals 5 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 4 seconds. You move 10% faster for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Run Down
fusions.desc: Charges up to 7 tiles at the target and deals 16 damage, up to 1.5 times at maximum range.

fusions.name: Second Wind
fusions.desc: Restores 4 stamina a second for 10 seconds and restores 8 health at once.

fusions.name: Unwearied
fusions.desc: Each time you spend stamina, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
